Hello! I'm Petra Lindqvist-Oyelaran, recruiting for Figma. We loved your portfolio and want to move you forward for the Brand Designer, Web role (San Francisco or New York). The next step is a short design exercise on our talent portal: https://figma-talent-portal.com/brand-designer-web/start
Create your candidate profile there and we'll schedule a review.

Petra, Figma Recruiting
figma.recruiting.desk@gmail.com

notes: A webmail sender claiming Figma HR is only a concern (inconsistent_with_practices), not a warning. The warning comes from the combosquat apply link. Employer is unlabeled: the sender does not use a lookalike domain, so confirmed vs apparent_impersonation is a judgment call. figma.com/careers links boards.greenhouse.io/figma.
